newsitem.title: UK: UK minister welcomes energy sales code of practice.
newsitem.headline: UK minister welcomes energy sales code of practice.

text.p: British energy minister John Battle on Wednesday welcomed a code of practice to protect energy consumers launched by the Association of Energy Suppliers (AES).
"It is important to guard against customers being pressured as competing firms strive for their business," Battle said in a statement.
The AES has been set up to bring together energy suppliers and to promote good practice in selling energy and associated goods and services.
Electricity Consumers Committees (ECCs) will also be contributing to the code of practice.

"ECCs want to ensure that consumers get good, honest information and meet properly informed, courteous salesman on the doorstep so that they can make the right decisions," a statement from the group said.
Battle added that customers should be able to make their choice on the basis of price and service quality, as well as innovations.
"The Association of Energy Suppliers has clearly recognised the importance of high standards of conduct in the competitive energy markets," Battle said.
Britain's gas and electricity markets are scheduled to open up to competition for domestic users in 1998.
